Synthetic test photos (made by `grain-counter/test/gen_bench.py`, cases H03 and R04, scaled to 1600 px), used by the
device tests in CI:

- `lentils_with_print.jpg` - 100 lentils on a sheet with printed text, a bold heading and symbols.
- `mixed_with_glare.jpg` - 60 grains (wheat and black pepper) on a glossy sheet with two flash reflections.
